  <title>GEMS HABITAT POINT DATASET</title>
  <abstract>Collation of habitat point records contributing to the Geodatabase of Marine features adjacent to Scotland (GeMS). Records are attributed as to their qualification as protected features of protected areas within the Scottish MPA network. Where appropriate typical record details will include: status as Scottish Priority Marine Features or Annex I Habitat, MNCR biotope, EUNIS habitat, date, date range, year, status, accuracy, determiner and details of where the records are sourced from and intellectual property ownership.


Collation of data (from varied sources) contributing to the Geodatabase of Marine features adjacent to Scotland (GeMS). Collation serves the purposes of: - supporting the Scottish Marine Protected Areas process; - sourcing data used in Scotland's National Marine Plan; - providing information on the known recorded distribution of Scottish Priority Marine Features; - providing information on the known distribution of recorded Habitats Directive Annex I features within Special Areas of Conservation.</abstract>

  <history>This feature class contains habitat point records that have been iteratively added on and since the initial creation of the dataset. Records are sourced from multiple data owners, and provided for addition to the dataset by either NatureScot or Joint Nature Conservation Committee. Intellectual Property Ownership of individual records is varied. Records were originally collected for a variety of purposes and record collection was done through a variety of methodologies. No records were originally collected with the specific purpose of inclusion within this collation; the dataset accepts records relevant to Priority Marine Features, MPA Search Features and Annex I habitat records. Records have had a standardised data structure applied, and as such may not include all the attributes available within their original source. Updates starting in 2025 will be named with the date of the version being published. Published version 11: Iteration 28 (16/09/2024) Published version 10: Iteration 26 (19/10/2021) - reflects further data additions: SNH Additions 176 to 188, edits and deletions Published version 9: Iteration 25 (08/02/2021) - reflects further data additions: SNH Additions 172 to 175 Published version 8: Iteration 24 - reflects further data additions: SNH Additions 148 to 171 (02/04/2020) Unpublished: Iteration 23 - reflects further data additions: SNH Additions 137 to 147 Published Version7: Iteration 22 - reflects revision to Burrowed mud extent in Southern Trench Unpublished: Iteration 21 - Additional data for Basking shark and Risso's dolphin Published Version 6: Iteration 20 [07/09/2018] to support PMF review consultation, also contains some data to support forthcoming Phase II Fisheries Management, and some data to support consultation on remaining Nature Conservation MPA proposals Unpublished: Iteration 19 [31/01/2018] Published Version5: Iteration 18 [24/01/2017] Unpublished: Iteration 17 [22/06/2015] Unpublished: Iteration 16 [01/05/2015] Published Version 4: Iteration 15 [24/02/2015] additions and changes to reflect data confidence assessments used at designation for JNCC led sites Unpublished: Iteration 14 [October 2014] additions and changes to reflect data confidence assessments used at designation for SNH led sites Published Version 3: Iteration 13 [03/07/2014] published immediately prior to MPA independent external review Unpublished: Iteration 12 [undated] Unpublished: Iteration11 [30/01/2014] supplied as interim release to Marine Scotland Published Version 2: Iteration 10 [31/05/2012] published to MPA stakeholder consultation process Published Version 1: Iteration 9 [17/06/2011] published to MPA stakeholder consultation process Unpublished: Iteration 8 [2011] Unpublished: Iteration 7 [2011] Unpublished: Iteration 6 [2011] Unpublished: Iteration 5 [2011] Unpublished: Iteration 4 [2011] Unpublished: Iteration 3 [2011] Unpublished: Iteration 2 [2011] Unpublished: Iteration 1 [2011]</history>

  <constraints type="Limitations of use">Details of permissions to mobilise for view download and re-use are documented against individual records in the CONSENT field. Likewise records of Native oyster or Native oyster habitat are considered Sensitive under NatureScot policy and are not to be released at full resolution; such records are tagged as "Sensitive" in the CONSENT field.</constraints>
